audit.whatIsWrong: Four stages contradict their own whys: Level 3 reads Gwen while its why says 'neither side cleanly wins', Levels 4-5 read Gwen while the why and spike call it 'her best window', Level 6 reads Neeko while the why says 'you own the duel from here', and 2+ items reads Gwen while the why ends 'the lane is even because she sidesteps the 1v1'.
audit.why: The matchup sits at exactly 50.0%. Neeko owns the pre-mist levels and the map; Gwen owns 6 through first item and the straight duel forever.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Neeko / Skill / Skill / Neeko / Gwen / Gwen / Skill in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Punish the long R cooldown' is written without the number, and no other cooldown appears.
audit.why: Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s, Tangle-Barbs 12s at rank 1, Blooming Burst 9s and Shapesplitter 16s. A dodged Pop Blossom at 6 is two full minutes of a Neeko who cannot start a fight.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the spikes, whys, wants and cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs is described as a flat root and Blooming Burst as a bounce, with none of the conditions that actually make them dangerous. Nor does anything say that Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden while she is disguised.
audit.why: Riot's text: Tangle-Barbs 'becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer' if it kills a unit or passes through a champion — so rooting yourself behind a minion wave makes the root worse, not safer. Blooming Burst 'blooms again on hitting champions or killing units', which is why standing in the wave doubles the poke. And Pop Blossom's preparation is HIDDEN while she is disguised, so the usual visual tell is gone against a Shapesplitter Neeko — the reason 'do not facecheck' is not just flavour.
audit.corrected: All three stated in the spikes, Key Ability Interactions, the cooldown breakdown and the late paragraph.

edits.before: Q+E lets you dash and reset, but her E root and Shapesplitter clone let her kite the trade to a wash — neither side cleanly wins here.
edits.after: Q+E lets you dash and reset, but Tangle-Barbs (12s) grows larger and roots longer through a minion, so the trade washes out.

edits.before: Still no mist, so her Q poke and E (Tangle-Barbs) root own you, and this is her best roam/gank window before your level-6 spike.
edits.after: Still no mist, so Blooming Burst (9s) and a 12-second Tangle-Barbs own you — her best roam and gank window before your six.

edits.before: You win the straight duel forever, but she's a pick-mage who roams with Shapesplitter disguise and Pop-Blossoms your team — the lane is even because she sidesteps the 1v1.
edits.after: You win the straight duel forever, but she is a pick-mage: disguised, her Pop Blossom wind-up is hidden, so she flanks instead of fighting and the lane nets even.

edits.before: Land E (Tangle-Barbs) root from a clone or fog of war to pin you and stack Q poke before you reach mist range
edits.after: Fire Tangle-Barbs through a minion so it lands bigger, faster and longer, then stack Blooming Burst poke

edits.before: Neeko's biggest pre-6 window: still no mist for you, so her Q poke plus an E (Tangle-Barbs) root chip you down and set up her cleanest roam or jungle gank.
edits.after: Her biggest pre-6 window: no mist for you, Blooming Burst (9s) blooms twice off the wave, and a Tangle-Barbs through a minion roots you for longer.

edits.before: You out-scale her in a straight 1v1 all day — her low base HP folds to %-max-HP Snip Snip! and your true-damage center snip, while your mist makes her untargetable burst whiff if she has to commit from outside it. But Neeko is a pick-mage, not a duelist: she'll Shapesplitter-disguise as a teammate, flank, and Pop Blossom your backline before you ever touch her. Don't get caught alone or facecheck for her clone. Group with vision, mist the engage, and make her blow R into your team where you can E on top of her and delete her.
edits.after: You out-scale her in a straight 1v1 all day — her low base HP folds to %-max-HP Snip Snip! and the true-damage center, while your mist blanks burst thrown from outside it. But Neeko is a pick-mage, not a duelist: she will Shapesplitter-disguise as a teammate, flank, and Pop Blossom your backline. Worse, while she is disguised the Pop Blossom preparation is HIDDEN, so the wind-up you would normally see is not there. Group with vision, mist the engage, and make her spend a 120-second R into your team where you can E on top of her.

edits.before: Track Neeko's Tangle-Barbs: Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-snip in the mist.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs (E, 12s) grows larger, faster and roots LONGER after passing through a champion or killing a minion.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs (E): 12s — bigger and longer if it passes through anything first. - Blooming Burst (Q): 9s, and it blooms twice off the wave. - Pop Blossom (R): 120/105/90s, wind-up hidden while disguised. - Shapesplitter: 16s.

notes: Neeko's passive breaks her disguise when she takes immobilizing crowd control. Needlework only slows, so it should not reveal her, but the kit file does not define whether a slow counts — I did not write it either way.
